messages.content: Please reprice the later Sedona weekend now. Compare both complete plans again, check the actual cancellation and deposit dates, and make sure there are still two spa appointments we can use without spending half the day waiting for each other.

For November 11-14, the nonstop flights are now $1,146.20 total for two: SFO-PHX 8:35-10:33 a.m. Thursday and PHX-SFO 6:20-8:25 p.m. Sunday. Canyon Light is $4,094.60 complete, including the midsize rental, breakfast for two, and two massages after its $300 spa credit. Red Rock Springs is $4,195.00 complete. Its room rate fell, but separate breakfasts and the remaining higher-priced spa times now make it $100.40 more than Canyon Light.
What appointment times are actually available at each? Also separate the deadlines. I do not want the room deadline confused with the spa deadline.

Canyon Light has one compatible pair left on Saturday: two 60-minute massages at 11:30 and 11:45 a.m. The spa requires a $280 deposit by 5:00 p.m. Arizona time tomorrow, October 28. That deposit is refundable through 5:00 p.m. November 6; after that it is forfeited for cancellation, and changes within 24 hours can incur the full treatment charge. The room can be canceled without penalty through 6:00 p.m. Arizona time October 28. Afterward, the room penalty is one night including tax, $755.60.

Red Rock Springs has massages at 1:40 and 2:10 p.m. Saturday. No advance spa deposit is required, but cancellation within 72 hours carries the full treatment charge. Its room remains cancelable without charge through 6:00 p.m. Arizona time November 4; afterward the penalty is one night including tax, $584.00.
The Canyon times are close enough. Confirm what is included in that total and give me the driving schedule from Phoenix both ways.

The $4,094.60 Canyon Light total consists of $1,146.20 for both airline tickets, $2,266.80 for three nights with tax and breakfast for two each morning, $383.20 net for both massages including the service charge after the $300 credit, and $298.40 for the midsize rental with taxes and fees. Fuel is not included.

On Thursday, the rental pickup is planned for 11:05 a.m. Allowing for baggage and the counter, you should leave PHX around 11:35 a.m. The usual drive plus a short stop puts you at Canyon Light around 1:45-2:05 p.m. Sunday, leave the resort at 1:30 p.m.; allow about two hours for the drive and fuel, return the car around 4:00 p.m., and reach the terminal roughly two hours before the 6:20 p.m. flight.
Is the airfare the same fare type in both comparisons, and what happens if we cancel it?

Yes. Both comparisons use the same standard economy fare on the same nonstop flights, with seat selection and one carry-on per traveler included. The tickets are nonrefundable, but they may be canceled before departure for airline credit in each traveler’s name. Checked bags would be additional. The quoted fare is live and is not being held.
Then choose Canyon Light. Before booking, verify that the breakfast benefit covers both of us on all three mornings and that the spa credit is not per room night.

Verified. Breakfast covers two registered guests on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, up to $45 per person per morning before gratuity. The spa benefit is one $300 credit for the entire stay, not $300 per night. It applies to the treatment charges but not the service charge. The Saturday 11:30 and 11:45 appointments can be linked to the room, but they remain available only until the spa inventory changes or the deposit is paid.
Proceed with the flights, Canyon Light, the midsize rental, and those two massages. Use Priya Nair and Anil Raj Nair as the travelers and guests.

I can complete all four components. The amount due now is $3,991.40: airfare, the room’s first-night deposit of $755.60, the $280 spa deposit, and the prepaid rental. The remaining $103.20 spa balance and $755.60 room balance are due at the resort. May I charge the leisure card ending in 6031 and accept the airline credit terms and the cancellation deadlines just reviewed?
Yes. Charge that card and complete everything.

The Sedona trip is booked for Priya Nair and Anil Raj Nair, November 11-14, 2027.

Flights: SFO-PHX Thursday 8:35-10:33 a.m. and PHX-SFO Sunday 6:20-8:25 p.m.; airline confirmation H6T9QK. Canyon Light: three nights with breakfast for two; confirmation CL4N82. The room is penalty-free until 6:00 p.m. Arizona time October 28, then subject to the $755.60 one-night penalty. Spa: Saturday massages at 11:30 and 11:45 a.m.; confirmation SPA7714. The $280 deposit is paid and remains refundable until 5:00 p.m. November 6. Rental: midsize pickup and return at PHX; confirmation PXR5D27.

The card ending in 6031 was charged $3,991.40. The projected complete trip total remains $4,094.60, excluding fuel, checked bags, and any breakfast amount above the daily allowance. Plan to leave PHX around 11:35 a.m. Thursday and Canyon Light at 1:30 p.m. Sunday.
